reason: I already sell one e-book on WhatsApp and it works: they ask, they pay by mobile money, I send the PDF. I still have to check the SMS and press send myself, so for one product I don't see why I'd pay 4 900 FCFA every month; at most I'd try the free page.
objection: I'm not comfortable with technical tools. Building a page, pasting a SasPay link, a domain... I'm scared of getting stuck, and I don't even have a SasPay account, my buyers pay me by Orange Money or Wave.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked directly with the mobile money my buyers already use and confirmed the payment automatically, and I had so many orders that doing it by hand was eating my evenings.
